description: Understand portable solar panel efficiency versus real output, why a 100W panel delivers 50 to 80W, and how heat, aim and shade change your charging.
directAnswer: Efficiency (18 to 23 percent for modern folding panels) only describes panel size per watt. In the field a hand-aimed 100 W panel gives about 50 to 80 W and 250 to 400 Wh on a sunny day because of heat, angle, shade and conversion losses.
